returns.decimals: Number of decimals `price` is scaled by.
returns.updatedAt: Timestamp the round was last updated.

lockForOfframp(uint256,address,bytes32,u.details: Caller must have approved this contract for at least `amount` of `token`.

params.rateExpiry: Seconds the locked rate stays valid for; must be within        [MIN_RATE_EXPIRY, MAX_RATE_EXPIRY].
params.recipientPhoneHash: keccak256 hash of the recipient's phone number — never the        plain-text number itself (PRD Section 1: closing the plain-text-PII gap from v1).
params.token: ERC20 token being sent by the user.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

settleOfframp(bytes32,address[],uint256).details: Status flips to Settled before the external swap call (checks-effects-interactions,      PRD Section 5.3). If the rate-lock window has passed, this reverts and the request      stays Locked so `refund` can unlock it instead — matching "transaksi revert -> dana      otomatis unlock (refund)" in PRD Section 5.1, step 6.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

getLatestBnbUsdPrice().notice: Latest BNB/USD rate from Chainlink (PRD Section 5.1, step 2).

lockForOfframp(uint256,address,bytes32,u.notice: Lock funds for a cross-rail offramp transfer (PRD Section 5.1, step 4).

refund(bytes32).notice: Refund a locked request whose rate-lock window expired before settlement.         Callable by anyone, including the original user (PRD Section 5.3 — state-desync         mitigation: "fungsi refund() yang bisa dipanggil siapa pun").

settleOfframp(bytes32,address[],uint256).notice: Settle a locked request by swapping the locked token into `stableToken` via         PancakeSwap (PRD Section 5.1, step 6). Proceeds go to `owner()`, which hands         them off for the (simulated) fiat conversion + disbursement legs.

settler().notice: Backend relayer authorized to call `settleOfframp` once it observes         `OfframpRequested` and the off-chain rate/fiat leg is ready (PRD Section 5.1, step 5).

stableToken().notice: Stable token requests are swapped into on settlement (e.g. a BUSD-pegged         testnet token). Owner-adjustable in case the testnet liquidity pair changes.
